preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line.strip()), int) and 3 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case input line (after the first line) is an integer N where 3 ≤ N ≤ 10^5.
Input contains at least one test case (T ≥ 1) followed by T lines of N values.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N or output_line.strip() == '-1' for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case N, the output line is either a space-separated permutation of length N or '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line.strip() != '-1') == any(all(P[i] ^ P[i+1] != P[i+2] for i in range(N-2)) for P in permutations(range(1, N+1))) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the output line is not '-1', it represents a permutation P of (1, 2, ..., N) where for all 1 ≤ i ≤ N-2, P[i] XOR P[i+1] ≠ P[i+2]. If no such permutation exists, the output line is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(set(map(int, output_line.split())) == set(range(1, N+1)) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the output line is not '-1', it is a permutation of integers from 1 to N (each integer appears exactly once).
